name: rs-ops
description: rs-sdk session operations: idle autocompact for the conductor (ported from kawaka's kx-ops).

autocompact.title: Autocompact
autocompact.description: Idle auto-compaction in rs-sdk sessions (user settings): on = an idle conductor over 25% plus a cancellable failsafe for any idle session at 75%; conductor-only = the conductor rule alone; off = never. /rs-autocompact on|off overrides it for one session.
